Arabic text: بِسْمِ اللَّـهِ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
Translation: In the Name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send Your blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: يَا مَنْ يَرْحَمُ مَنْ لَا يَرْحَمُهُ الْعِبَادُ
Translation: O He who has mercy on those whom the servants do not have mercy on

Arabic text: وَ يَا مَنْ يَقْبَلُ مَنْ لَا تَقْبَلُهُ الْبِلَادُ
Translation: And O He who accepts those whom the lands do not accept

Arabic text: وَ يَا مَنْ لَا يَحْتَقِرُ أَهْلَ الْحَاجَةِ إِلَيْهِ
Translation: And O He who does not look down upon those who are in need of Him

Arabic text: وَ يَا مَنْ لَا يُخَيِّبُ الْمُلِحِّينَ عَلَيْهِ
Translation: And O He who does not disappoint those who insist on [asking] Him

Arabic text: وَ يَا مَنْ لَا يَجْبَهُ بِالرَّدِّ أَهْلَ الدَّالَّةِ عَلَيْهِ
Translation: And O He who does not rebuke with rejection those who have confidence in Him

Arabic text: وَ يَا مَنْ يَجْتَبِيْ صَغِيرَ مَا يُتْحَفُ بِهِ
Translation: And O He who accepts even the smallest gift presented to Him

Arabic text: وَ يَشْكُرُ يَسِيرَ مَا يُعْمَلُ لَهُ
Translation: And who thanks for the slightest work done for Him

Arabic text: وَ يَا مَنْ يَشْكُرُ عَلَى الْقَلِيلِ وَ يُجَازِيْ بِالْجَلِيلِ
Translation: And O He who thanks for the little and rewards with the great

Arabic text: وَ يَا مَنْ يَدْنُوْ إِلَى مَنْ دَنَا مِنْهُ
Translation: And O He who draws near to one who approaches Him

Arabic text: وَ يَا مَنْ يَدْعُوْ إِلَى نَفْسِهِ مَنْ أَدْبَرَ عَنْهُ
Translation: And O He who calls to Himself whoever turns away from Him

Arabic text: وَ يَا مَنْ لَا يُغَيِّرُ النِّعْمَةَ، وَ لَا يُبَادِرُ بِالنَّقِمَةِ
Translation: And O He who does not change the blessing, nor hastens to punishment

Arabic text: وَ يَا مَنْ يُثْمِرُ الْحَسَنَةَ حَتَّى يُنْمِيَهَا
Translation: And O He who causes the good deed to bear fruit until it grows

Arabic text: وَ يَتَجَاوَزُ عَنِ السَّيِّئَةِ حَتَّى يُعَفِّيَهَا
Translation: And overlooks the evil deed until He erases it

Arabic text: إِنْصَرَفَتِ الْآمَالُ دُوْنَ مَدَى كَرَمِكَ بِالْحَاجَاتِ
Translation: Hopes turn back with needs before reaching the extent of Your generosity

Arabic text: وَ امْتَلَأَتْ بِفَيْضِ جُودِكَ أَوْعِيَةُ الطَّلِبَاتِ
Translation: And the vessels of requests are filled with the abundance of Your munificence

Arabic text: وَ تَفَسَّخَتْ دُوْنَ بُلُوغِ نَعْتِكَ الصِّفَاتُ
Translation: And descriptions fall apart before reaching the reality of Your attributes

Arabic text: فَلَكَ الْعُلُوُّ الْأَعْلَى فَوْقَ كُلِّ عَالٍ
Translation: For You is the highest elevation above every high one

Arabic text: وَ الْجَلَالُ الْأَمْجَدُ فَوْقَ كُلِّ جَلَالٍ
Translation: And the most glorious majesty above every majesty

Arabic text: كُلُّ جَلِيلٍ عِنْدَكَ صَغِيرٌ
Translation: Every great thing is small before You

Arabic text: وَ كُلُّ شَرِيفٍ فِيْ جَنْبِ شَرَفِكَ حَقِيرٌ
Translation: And every noble thing is insignificant compared to Your nobility

Arabic text: خَابَ الْوَافِدُوْنَ عَلَى غَيْرِكَ
Translation: Those who approach other than You are disappointed

Arabic text: وَ خَسِرَ الْمُتَعَرِّضُونَ إِلَّا لَكَ، وَ ضَاعَ الْمُلِمُّونَ إِلَّا بِكَ
Translation: And those who seek from other than You lose, and those who resort to other than You are ruined

Arabic text: وَ أَجْدَبَ الْمُنْتَجِعُونَ إِلَّا مَنِ انْتَجَعَ فَضْلَكَ
Translation: And those who seek provision elsewhere suffer drought except for the one who seeks Your bounty

Arabic text: بَابُكَ مَفْتُوحٌ لِلرَّاغِبِينَ، وَ جُودُكَ مُبَاحٌ لِلسَّائِلِينَ
Translation: Your door is open to those who desire, and Your generosity is available to those who ask

Arabic text: وَ إِغَاثَتُكَ قَرِيبَةٌ مِنَ الْمُسْتَغِيثِينَ
Translation: And Your help is near to those who seek assistance

Arabic text: لَا يَخِيبُ مِنْكَ الْآمِلُونَ، وَ لَا يَيْأَسُ مِنْ عَطَائِكَ الْمُتَعَرِّضُونَ
Translation: Those who hope in You are not disappointed, and those who seek Your giving do not despair

Arabic text: وَ لَا يَشْقَى بِنَقِمَتِكَ الْمُسْتَغْفِرُونَ
Translation: And those who seek Your forgiveness are not made miserable by Your punishment

Arabic text: رِزْقُكَ مَبْسُوطٌ لِمَنْ عَصَاكَ
Translation: Your provision is extended even to those who disobey You

Arabic text: وَ حِلْمُكَ مُعْتَرِضٌ لِمَنْ نَاوَاكَ
Translation: And Your forbearance presents itself to those who contend with You

Arabic text: عَادَتُكَ الْإِحْسَانُ إِلَى الْمُسِيئِينَ
Translation: Your habit is to do good to the wrongdoers

Arabic text: وَ سُنَّتُكَ الْإِبْقَاءُ عَلَى الْمُعْتَدِيْنَ
Translation: And Your way is to be forbearing with transgressors

Arabic text: حَتَّى لَقَدْ غَرَّتْهُمْ أَنَاتُكَ عَنِ الرُّجُوعِ
Translation: Until Your slowness has deluded them from returning

Arabic text: وَ صَدَّهُمْ إِمْهَالُكَ عَنِ النُّزُوعِ
Translation: And Your respite has deterred them from desisting

Arabic text: وَ إِنَّمَا تَأَنَّيْتَ بِهِمْ لِيَفِيْؤُوْا إِلَى أَمْرِكَ
Translation: You were slow with them only so they would return to Your command

Arabic text: وَ أَمْهَلْتَهُمْ ثِقَةً بِدَوَامِ مُلْكِكَ
Translation: And You gave them respite out of confidence in the permanence of Your kingdom

Arabic text: فَمَنْ كَانَ مِنْ أَهْلِ السَّعَادَةِ خَتَمْتَ لَهُ بِهَا
Translation: So whoever was among the people of happiness, You sealed it for him

Arabic text: وَ مَنْ كَانَ مِنْ أَهْلِ الشَّقَاوَةِ خَذَلْتَهُ لَهَا
Translation: And whoever was among the people of wretchedness, You abandoned him to it

Arabic text: كُلُّهُمْ صَائِرُونَ إِلَى حُكْمِكَ، وَ اُمُورُهُمْ آئِلَةٌ إِلَى أَمْرِكَ
Translation: All of them are proceeding to Your judgment, and their affairs are returning to Your command

Arabic text: لَمْ يَهِنْ عَلَى طُولِ مُدَّتِهِمْ سُلْطَانُكَ
Translation: Your authority has not weakened despite the length of their term

Arabic text: وَ لَمْ يَدْحَضْ لِتَرْكِ مُعَاجَلَتِهِمْ بُرْهَانُكَ
Translation: And Your proof has not been refuted by Your delay in hastening against them

Arabic text: حُجَّتُكَ قَائِمَةٌ لَا تُدْحَضُ
Translation: Your argument stands and cannot be refuted

Arabic text: وَ سُلْطَانُكَ ثَابِتٌ لَا يَزُولُ
Translation: And Your authority is established and does not diminish

Arabic text: فَالْوَيْلُ الدَّائِمُ لِمَنْ جَنَحَ عَنْكَ
Translation: So perpetual woe to him who turns away from You

Arabic text: وَ الْخَيْبَةُ الْخَاذِلَةُ لِمَنْ خَابَ مِنْكَ
Translation: And humiliating disappointment to him who is disappointed by You

Arabic text: وَ الشَّقَاءُ الْأَشْقَى لِمَنِ اغْتَرَّ بِكَ
Translation: And the most wretched misery to him who is deluded about You

Arabic text: مَا أَكْثَرَ تَصَرُّفَهُ فِيْ عَذَابِكَ
Translation: How numerous are his movements in Your punishment

Arabic text: وَ مَا أَطْوَلَ تَرَدُّدَهُ فِيْ عِقَابِكَ
Translation: And how lengthy is his back-and-forth in Your chastisement

Arabic text: وَ مَا أَبْعَدَ غَايَتَهُ مِنَ الْفَرَجِ
Translation: And how far is his ultimate end from relief

Arabic text: وَ مَا أَقْنَطَهُ مِنْ سُهُولَةِ الْمَخْرَجِ
Translation: And how despairing he is of an easy way out

Arabic text: عَدْلًا مِنْ قَضَائِكَ لَا تَجُورُ فِيهِ
Translation: [This is] justice from Your decree in which You do not wrong

Arabic text: وَ إِنْصَافًا مِنْ حُكْمِكَ لَا تَحِيفُ عَلَيْهِ
Translation: And fairness from Your judgment in which You do not deviate

Arabic text: فَقَدْ ظَاهَرْتَ الْحُجَجَ، وَ أَبْلَيْتَ الْأَعْذَارَ
Translation: You have made Your proofs evident and exhausted excuses

Arabic text: وَ قَدْ تَقَدَّمْتَ بِالْوَعِيدِ، وَ تَلَطَّفْتَ فِيْ التَّرْغِيبِ
Translation: You have already given warning and been kind in encouragement

Arabic text: وَ ضَرَبْتَ الْأَمْثَالَ، وَ أَطَلْتَ الْإِمْهَالَ
Translation: You have set forth examples and extended the respite

Arabic text: وَ أَخَّرْتَ وَ أَنْتَ مُسْتَطِيعٌ لِلمُعَاجَلَةِ
Translation: And You have delayed while You are capable of immediate action

Arabic text: وَ تَأَنَّيْتَ وَ أَنْتَ مَلِيءٌ بِالْمُبَادَرَةِ
Translation: And You have been patient while You are full of readiness to hasten

Arabic text: لَمْ تَكُنْ أَنَاتُكَ عَجْزًا، وَ لَا إِمْهَالُكَ وَهْنًا
Translation: Your slowness was not due to inability, nor Your respite due to weakness

Arabic text: وَ لَا إِمْسَاكُكَ غَفْلَةً، وَ لَا انْتِظَارُكَ مُدَارَاةً
Translation: Nor Your restraint due to heedlessness, nor Your waiting due to compromise

Arabic text: بَلْ لِتَكُونَ حُجَّتُكَ أَبْلَغَ، وَ كَرَمُكَ أَكْمَلَ
Translation: But so that Your proof may be more conclusive, and Your generosity more perfect

Arabic text: وَ إِحْسَانُكَ أَوْفَى، وَ نِعْمَتُكَ أَتَمَّ
Translation: And Your goodness more complete, and Your blessing more full

Arabic text: كُلُّ ذٰلِكَ كَانَ وَ لَمْ تَزَلْ، وَ هُوَ كَائِنٌ وَ لَا تَزَالُ
Translation: All of that has been and You have never ceased, and it will be and You will never cease

Arabic text: حُجَّتُكَ أَجَلُّ مِنْ أَنْ تُوصَفَ بِكُلِّهَا
Translation: Your argument is too majestic to be described completely

Arabic text: وَ مَجْدُكَ أَرْفَعُ مِنْ أَنْ يُحَدَّ بِكُنْهِهِ
Translation: And Your glory is too exalted to be limited in its essence

Arabic text: وَ نِعْمَتُكَ أَكْثَرُ مِنْ أَنْ تُحْصَى بِأَسْرِهَا
Translation: And Your blessing is too numerous to be counted in its entirety

Arabic text: وَ إِحْسَانُكَ أَكْثَرُ مِنْ أَنْ تُشْكَرَ عَلَى أَقَلِّهِ
Translation: And Your goodness is too abundant to be thanked even for its least part

Arabic text: وَ قَدْ قَصَّرَ بِيَ السُّكُوتُ عَنْ تَحْمِيدِكَ
Translation: Silence has made me fall short of praising You

Arabic text: وَ فَهَّهَنِيَ الْإِمْسَاكُ عَنْ تَمْجِيدِكَ
Translation: And restraint has made me incapable of glorifying You

Arabic text: وَ قُصَارَايَ الْإِقْرَارُ بِالْحُسُورِ
Translation: The utmost I can do is admit my limitations

Arabic text: لَا رَغْبَةً يَا إِلَهِيْ بَلْ عَجْزًا
Translation: Not out of choice, my God, but out of inability

Arabic text: فَهَا أَنَا ذَا أَؤُمُّكَ بِالْوِفَادَةِ، وَ أَسْأَلُكَ حُسْنَ الرِّفَادَةِ
Translation: So here I am, coming to You as a delegate, and asking You for excellent support

Arabic text: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ، وَ اسْمَعْ نَجْوَايَ
Translation: So send blessings upon Muhammad and his family, and hear my confidential talk

Arabic text: وَ اسْتَجِبْ دُعَائِيْ، وَ لَا تَخْتِمْ يَوْمِيْ بِخَيْبَتِي
Translation: And answer my prayer, and do not end my day with disappointment

Arabic text: وَ لَا تَجْبَهْنِيْ بِالرَّدِّ فِيْ مَسْأَلَتِي
Translation: And do not reject me in my request

Arabic text: وَ أَكْرِمْ مِنْ عِنْدِكَ مُنْصَرَفِيْ وَ إِلَيْكَ مُنْقَلَبِي
Translation: And honor my departure from Your presence and my return to You

Arabic text: إِنَّكَ غَيْرُ ضَائِقٍ بِمَا تُرِيدُ، وَ لَا عَاجِزٍ عَمَّا تُسْأَلُ
Translation: Indeed, You are not constrained by what You will, nor incapable of what You are asked

Arabic text: وَ أَنْتَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
Translation: And You have power over all things

Arabic text: وَ لَا حَوْلَ وَ لَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمِ
Translation: And there is no might nor power except with Allah, the Most High, the Most Great
